claim: Showing measurable return in black and white made the sale easier.
reasoning: Buyer stops seeing a cost and starts seeing an investment.
evidence: “clients could see in black and white that it wasn't an expense, it was an investment with a measurable return.”
conditions: You can show a number the buyer already believes (hours, margin, cycle).
exceptions: If you cannot measure, this frame is theater.
action: Put the return on one page before the workflow tour.
confidence: high as his attribution; causal claim untested.
speaker: Nate Herk

mechanism: Inquiry in → quote out → CRM fields (name, email, phone, location, summary).
evidence: Full list of logged fields on tape.
conditions: There is an orders team and a CRM; quote can be generated from the inquiry.
exceptions: Auto-send of the quote is not specified as the hard step — do not assume send.

confidence: high for the described job; low for “accurate” as FACT.
speaker: Nate Herk
